name: Minimal Missing Patterns Have Strictly Positive Separators
statement: If a nonempty complete sign class has an affine-convex realization and $p$ is a minimal missing sign pattern on support $P$, then there are strictly positive coefficients $\lambda_e$ such that $\sum_{e\in P}\lambda_e\epsilon_e f_e(z)\le0$ throughout the realizing convex domain.
proof: Separate the affine image of the realizing domain from the disjoint open orthant cylinder specified by the missing pattern. Free coordinates force the separating functional to be supported on $P$, and unbounded signed directions make its coefficients nonnegative. If a coefficient vanished, minimality would supply a strict witness for the proper positive-support subpattern, contradicting separation; hence all coefficients are positive.
